public.title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
public.description: Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: the root comes first, then the left and right children of each non-null node in queue order; null means absent and trailing nulls may be omitted. Empty arrays mean no root. Return each tree level as an array, alternating left-to-right at depth zero and right-to-left at depth one. At most 500 nodes with values from -1000 to 1000.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Collect each level in structural order and reverse only the output for odd depths. O(n) time and space.
